policy: Age-up can only happen through the spa world flow, creates a separate older/taller variant, and requires a separate confirmed_adult classification before immediate adult-curriculum assignment or any separately chosen adult-anatomy build.

stage_1.scope: Make the separate variant older and taller from the Age Progression process, refit proportions and rig, and record the adult_aged_up_variant presentation/build label without treating that label or spa completion as confirmed_adult.
required_evidence: at least two prior activations verified
confirmed_adult classification not inferred from spa completion

stage_2.scope: Author adult anatomy only on the separate confirmed adult variant after Stage 1 passes and the resident's separate adult-anatomy choice is recorded.

owner_continuity_authority.rule: Robert's explicit fictional/character continuity, timepoint, or adult-version correction is authoritative when logged. Uncertainty may be corrected; an explicitly non-adult body is never aged up in place.

rules: The normal version of a non-adult character remains non-adult-safe.
An explicitly non-adult body is never aged up in place; Stage 1 uses a distinct candidate ID and variant profile.
Stage 1 changes only the older/taller presentation/build state, records the adult_aged_up_variant label, keeps exact maturity unresolved, and must remain non-adult-safe anatomically.
The adult_aged_up_variant presentation/build label is not the separate exact confirmed_adult maturity classification.
Spa completion alone does not assign the complete adult curriculum and never adds adult anatomy.

When the separate resulting variant is exactly classified confirmed_adult, assign the complete adult curriculum immediately without waiting for relationship, interest, anatomy selection, or experience.
Stage 1 is blocked unless temporary origin is verified, the temporary is permanently promoted, has at least two verified prior activations, chooses Age Progression, and enters the recorded spa flow.
Stage 2 adult anatomy remains blocked until exact Stage 1 evidence, confirmed-adult classification, spa eligibility, and the resident's separate adult-anatomy choice pass.
An age-progressed presentation variant is irreversible once approved in the story state; that irreversibility does not establish confirmed adulthood.
There is no undo or de-age operation after spa age-up.

Adult anatomy and adult clothing/body assets unlock for ordinary exact confirmed adults or for an age-progressed variant only after Stage 1, separate exact confirmed-adult classification, and the resident's separate Stage 2 choice pass.
The system must record who was aged up, their durable choice, when, and which append-only adult variant assets were created.
A maturity correction or successful private build is not body approval and never activates or publishes the candidate.
blocked_actions: silently converting a non-adult avatar to an adult body
using an isolated earlier-era keyword to override an explicit later adult continuity request
using adult anatomy references on a normal non-adult avatar
merging adult and non-adult asset states into one unlabeled character
